title: [GMCP 203.001.M] Mastery: Normative requirements ledger and standards drift
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-001-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: A machine-readable requirements ledger covers every applicable MCP 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28 MUST, SHOULD, error, deprecation, security rule, official extension, and implementation claim. Every row traces to an owner, production path, positive and negative test, evidence artifact, and disposition; automated upstream drift detection fails closed on an unclassified change. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
